title: 3-Cheese Garlic Butter Beef & Noodles
creator: Sean Alexander (seanyboycooks)
prepTime: Not specified (ground beef goes in already cooked and crumbled; egg noodles cooked separately)
cookTime: About 1 hour on HIGH in a slow cooker, plus a few minutes to melt in the cheese
ingredients: 1½ lb ground beef (shown already cooked and crumbled in the slow cooker)
About 2 tsp garlic ("a couple teaspoons"; the video shows garlic powder)
1 package Philadelphia cream cheese (package size not stated)
instructions: Step 1: Add the 1½ lb ground beef to the slow cooker and put the 4 tbsp butter on top, spreading it around.
Step 2: Add about 2 teaspoons of garlic and the packet of onion soup mix.
Step 3: Add the package of Philadelphia cream cheese and mix it around the meat.
Step 4: Pour in 1 cup beef broth and 1 cup heavy cream, then stir for a few seconds so the flavors mix.
Step 5: Put the lid on and cook on HIGH for 1 hour.
Step 6: Remove the lid and stir. Add ½ cup Parmesan, 2 cups mozzarella, and 1 cup shredded cheddar; stir until melted.
Step 7: Fold in 12 oz cooked egg noodles until combined, then serve.
notes: From a Sean Alexander Facebook reel captioned '3-Cheese Garlic Butter Beef & Noodles! 🤤 Creamy, cheesy, buttery comfort food at its finest.' The caption has no written recipe and Facebook comments were behind a login wall, so the recipe comes from the creator's narration in the same video cross-posted on his YouTube channel seanyboycooks (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FfGN-U6KeUg); the steps match what the Facebook reel shows. Unclear: the cream cheese package size isn't stated, the beef appears to be browned/drained beforehand (not shown or said), and how the noodles are cooked isn't covered. Servings not stated.
